name: suns-of-rubi-core
description: Suns of Rubi Core system module for Foundry VTT (v12/v14, dnd5e)
author: bandrewbobb

scripts.build: npx fvtt package pack -n class-features -t Item --in src/features --out packs -r && npx fvtt package pack -n classes -t Item --in src/classes --out packs && npx fvtt package pack -n nanoprograms -t Item --in src/nanoprograms --out packs -r && npx fvtt package pack -n journals -t JournalEntry --in src/journals --out packs && npx fvtt package pack -n companions -t Actor --in src/actors --out packs && npx fvtt package pack -n feats -t Item --in src/feats --out packs -r && npx fvtt package pack -n backgrounds -t Item --in src/backgrounds --out packs && npx fvtt package pack -n species-features -t Item --in src/features/species --out packs -r && npx fvtt package pack -n species -t Item --in src/species --out packs && npx fvtt package pack -n weapons -t Item --in src/items/weapons --out packs -r && npx fvtt package pack -n armor -t Item --in src/items/armor --out packs -r && npx fvtt package pack -n gear -t Item --in src/items/gear --out packs -r && npx fvtt package pack -n hardware-mods -t Item --in src/items/hardware-mods --out packs -r
